scores.notes: Both show the same plank-built wooden boat with a patched cream sail, rope-bound stern post and a sack cushion in the stern, on a dark lake under storm cloud with low green hills on the far shore; only the storm easing differs, which the passages ask for.

Both show a wet, muddy seabed path opening through dark green-grey breaking water under a black storm sky; the left adds the near shore with palms and a distant walled town, the right the far red cliffs, which are compatible views of one crossing.

Both show the same puddled, rock-strewn sandy seabed between towering blue-green water walls receding to a far shore; the left sky is darker and its far hills grey where the right shows red mesas, but the corridor itself matches and the far end is mostly hidden by spray on the left.

Both show a dry, pale dirt track through olive-dotted hill country with flat-roofed pale stone houses and a cypress; the left is the wide view down the road toward the farmstead, the right a close view in front of such a house, which fits together.

Moses with the crook staff is an elderly man with white hair and a full white beard, a lean weathered face and a dark brown cloak over a cream tunic in both; his hair and beard look shorter and neater in the left crowd view than in the windblown right, but colour, age and build agree.

Both show the same wet ochre sandy seabed with scattered rocks and seaweed running between rising blue-green water; the right is the near sandy shore with palms under a darker sky as the sea opens, the left the corridor looking back to desert cliffs, which are compatible views.
Moses with the crook staff is in both an elderly man with swept-back white hair, a long full white beard, the same lined tanned face and a brown cloak over a belted cream tunic.

Both show a grey pebble shore with a small cooking fire at the edge of a wide lake backed by low dark hills with reeds and scrub; the left looks toward a hillside village in warmer breaking light and the right along a darker stretch of the bank, which is compatible.

Both show a plank-built wooden boat with a single mast and cream square sail on a dark, white-capped lake under storm cloud with steep hilly shores behind; the stern post is curled on the right and plain on the left, a small difference against the matching boat, water and shoreline.

Daniel beside the angel (left) and Daniel being lifted from the pit (right) both have short grey hair, a short trimmed grey beard, a lean older brown-skinned face and the same blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a strap pouch.

Daniel climbing the rope (left) and Daniel standing among the lions (right) both have short cropped grey hair, a short grey beard, a lean older brown-skinned face and the same blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a waist pouch.

Peter standing with the net by the fire (left) and Peter jumping from the boat (right) both have thick dark curly hair greying at the sides, a short grey-flecked beard, a sturdy middle-aged build and a rough brown cloak.

Daniel standing among the lions (left) and Daniel held by the soldiers in the pit (right) both have short grey hair, a short grey beard, an older lean face and the same blue fringed robe over a cream tunic with a shoulder pouch; the right figure is smaller but shows no conflicting cue.

Both show an ochre sandy seabed with seaweed, shells and rock outcrops running through green white-crested sea beside reddish desert cliffs; the left is the dark night view as the sea begins to divide, which the passage's night wind asks for, and the right the open corridor in daylight.

Peter plunging through the water in the brown cloak (left) and the standing man in the rough brown cloak holding the net (right) both have short dark curly hair greying at the temples, a short grey-flecked beard and a weathered middle-aged face.

Both show the same plank-built wooden boat with a rope-bound stern post and cushion in the stern on a dark blue-green, white-capped lake in driving rain with green scrubby hills on the shore; the left mast is bare where the right carries a patched sail, a small difference against the matching water, shore and boat.

Both show a wet brown sandy seabed running through teal white-crested sea under heavy storm cloud; the right is the dark near shore with palms and a town as the water begins to divide, which the passage's night wind asks for, and the left looks along the open corridor to red cliffs on the far side.

Both show the same plank-built wooden boat with a rope-bound stern post on a dark blue-green lake under storm cloud with steep scrubby hills along the shore; the left carries a patched sail where the right mast is bare, but the lake and shoreline match and the calming is the requested change.

Jesus standing in the boat (left) and crouching at the fire (right) both have shoulder-length dark brown hair parted in the middle, a short dark beard, the same lean face and a cream tunic under a blue-grey mantle.
Both show a wet sandy seabed corridor between towering dark-green wave walls under storm cloud, leading back to a sandy shore with red sandstone cliffs.

Both show a calm lake cove under tawny cliff-topped hills with a whitewashed flat-roofed village and cypresses on the far slope, and a fire on a low stony shore; the right's shore is grassier with olive trees but seen from the water at a distance.
Jesus (standing in the boat left, crouching at the fire right) has the same shoulder-length dark brown hair, short dark beard, slim face and age, plus the same white tunic and blue-grey mantle.

Both show the same single-masted wooden boat on a grey-green lake under storm cloud with tawny hills and a small village with cypresses on the shore; only the sea state and sail differ, as the passages require.

Left is the courtyard of pale limestone flat-roofed houses and right the stony road outside a village of the same pale stone houses; both look out over the same rolling olive-dotted hills to a distant lake under broken cloud.
Both show the same single-masted wooden boat with a furled/loose canvas sail on a dark heaving sea with dark headlands on the right horizon under storm cloud; the left adds only a break of light.

Both show an open single-masted wooden boat with oars and rope coils on a grey-green lake under dark storm cloud with low hills on the horizon; the left boat has a scroll-carved sternpost the right lacks, a minor detail against the matching lake, hills and boat type.

Peter (walking up the beach in a brown cloak left, leaping from the boat right) has in both short curly dark hair going grey, a short grey-flecked beard, tanned weathered face, middle age and sturdy build.

Both show the inside of a deep circular pit of large grey stone blocks with a sandy rubble floor, a parapet rim where the king leans over, and rough rock rising behind the rim in pale daylight; the winch and the propped wooden cover are compatible fittings.

Both show a sandy shell-and-stone-strewn seabed path through teal-green water with red-ochre desert cliffs on the shore, in daylight on the land; the right sky is heavy storm cloud and the left is clear, but the land, water and path agree as the parting progresses.

Both show an open-topped circular pit of pale dressed stone blocks with a sandy floor and a parapet rim, in daylight with palms and dry earth above; the left's wooden doors at the rim and the right's barred arch with steps differ in detail but the pit itself agrees.

Left is the dirt road outside pale limestone flat-roofed houses with dry-stone walls and right is the paved yard of a pale limestone house with dry-stone walls; both sit among the same terraced olive hills in clear daylight.
Both show the same dark open wooden boat with a single mast and ragged sail in a black rain-lashed storm on dark green-grey waves, with dark cliffed headlands in the background.

Both show the same dark wooden boat with a single mast and furled cream sail on a yard, on a dark green-grey heaving sea with dark cliffed headlands behind under storm cloud; the right only adds breaking light.

Moses (seen from behind in part-profile with raised crook left; front right with crook right) is in both an elderly man with white hair and a full white beard, lean build, brown mantle over a pale tunic and the same crook staff; the back view on the left hides most of the face but no cue conflicts.

Both show an open-topped pit walled in curved courses of grey dressed stone with a sandy floor and lions, in daylight with palms and dry ground above; the left looks wider and has a tall wooden door in the wall while the right shows a well-like rim with a cover and grate, but the stonework, form and surroundings agree.

Jesus (seated by the fire left, standing in the bow right) has in both shoulder-length dark brown hair, a short dark beard, the same slim face, age and build, with the same cream tunic and dark blue mantle.

Both show a sandy seabed corridor strewn with shells and seaweed between towering grey-green wave walls, leading to the same flat-topped red sandstone mesas on the far shore in daylight; the left sky is a little cloudier.

Both show a wet ochre-sand seabed path with puddles and rocks opening through dark slate-blue water under the same black storm sky, with a sandy bluff at the left edge; the walls of water are simply higher on the right.

Both show a calm blue lake under a clear sky with a pebbly sandy shore and a fire at the water's edge, low stone flat-roofed houses, cypresses and olive trees on tawny green slopes with cliffed hills beyond.
